    On this page

      Playground

      See the protocol move

      Three simulators that follow the same rules as Socket.IO 4.8. Change things and watch what happens.

      Paste a packet

      Copy a frame from DevTools (Network → the transport=websocket request → Messages) or a polling response. Several polling packets can be separated by a new line.

      Choose an emit

      You are socket A (dashed outline). The server runs this line inside A's event handler.

      Client reconnection settings

      Same formula as socket.io-client: delay × 2attempt, randomly moved up or down by up to the randomization factor, then capped at the max.

      Delay before each attempt

      1,000 clients after a server restart

      When each client makes its first reconnection attempt. Without jitter they all hit the server in the same instant.
